{{Quote|Gravus failed to keep the Republic at bay in the Mid Rim.|[[Darth Marr]]|<ref name="Annihilation" />}}
During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[3640 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Gravus]], after he successfully [[Invasion of Taris|conquered]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], was put in charge of a fleet above the mineral-rich [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Leritor/Legends|Leritor]].
However, a Republic fleet appeared and defeated the Sith warships, thus conquering the planet and forcing Gravus to retreat for the moment, weakening his position in the eyes of the [[Dark Council]].
Afterwords, a [[Second battle of Leritor|second battle]] was fought here that saw the Empire reclaim the planet, but also saw the death of Darth Gravus at the hands of a rival Sith Lord, [[Darth Karrid]].
